analysis.headline: Global ETF Rotation Analysis: EAFE Developed Equities and U.S. Value Lead While Technology and Emerging Markets Experience Broad Weakness
analysis.market_regime: Divergent / Developed & Value Sector Leadership vs Technology & Emerging Market Weakness
analysis.executive_summary: Quantitative monitoring highlights significant rotation across international and sector asset classes. Developed international equities (EFA score 95.71) and U.S. MidCap 400 (MDY score 95.0) show strong emerging relative leadership, while Global Consumer Staples (KXI score 89.5) and Global Health Care (IXJ score 88.5) maintain persistent leadership streaks. Direct pair spreads confirm relative strength in Large-Cap Value (IWD score 89.6) over Large-Cap Growth (IWF) and S&P 500 Equal Weight (RSP score 81.31) over Cap Weight (SPY). Conversely, broad technology (XLK score 31.82, IXN score 19.5), semiconductors (SMH score 20.93), and select emerging markets (EPU score 13.29, EWY score 14.51) reflect multi-horizon relative deterioration and rotation-out conditions.

cross_market_confirmations: Strong relative leadership in Developed Europe (VGK score 88.12) is confirmed at the country level by Switzerland (EWL score 92.56) and globally by EAFE Developed (EFA score 95.71).
Weakness in U.S. Information Technology (XLK score 31.82) and Semiconductors (SMH score 20.93) is confirmed globally by Global Technology (IXN score 19.5, 63-bar score low).
Defensive sector strength in U.S. Consumer Staples (XLP score 66.36) aligns with Global Consumer Staples (KXI score 89.5, 63-bar score high).
risks_or_conflicts: A major within-sector divergence exists in Health Care: Pharmaceuticals (XPH) is an improver with a 20-bar score change of +25.56, while broad Health Care (XLV) is a deteriorator with a 20-bar score change of -17.73 (divergence of 43.28 score points).

Several securities present pending trend changes that differ from confirmed canonical states: XLRE is confirmed NEUTRAL with pending EMERGING (2/3 observations), INDA is confirmed EMERGING with pending PERSISTENT_LEADER (2/3 observations), IXN is confirmed WEAKENING with pending ROTATION_OUT (2/3 observations), and XHB is confirmed NEUTRAL with pending EMERGING (2/3 observations).

Conflicting horizon metrics are present where 20-bar and 63-bar relative strength have opposite signs: S&P MidCap 400 (MDY) displays 20-bar RS of +4.6 percentage points versus 63-bar RS of -1.65 percentage points, while Latin America (ILF) exhibits 20-bar RS of -13.02 percentage points versus 63-bar RS of +0.83 percentage points.
analysis.methodology_note: Interpretation uses Python-confirmed trend states that require 3 consecutive daily observations before a new raw condition becomes canonical. Raw conditions remain available as pending early warnings. Evidence also uses deterministic 5-bar score changes, 20- and 63-bar relative strength or pair spreads, persistence metrics, and Python-calculated attention flags including 63-bar rotation-score extrema and material cross-market conflicts. ETF volume and CMF are treated as market-participation indicators, not fund-flow data.
